name: Anxious_1
short_caption: The robot nervously brings its hands together near its waist, tilting and turning its head anxiously, before returning to a neutral pose.
movement_description: The robot begins by bringing both hands inward to its waist, fingers partially open, as if in a self-conscious or protective gesture. Simultaneously, it tilts its head to its left and rotates its head to look slightly upward and to the right. After a brief pause in this defensive posture, it relaxes its arms back down to its sides and returns its head to the forward-facing neutral position.
